name: ZFP HiNET Repeater panel Multipath Network Surface mount
subtitle: Requires a Separate PSU; includes network interface PCB
legacyName: ZFP HiNET Repeater panel Multipath Network (includes network interface PCB) Surface mount- Requires a Separate PSU
family: Analogue Addressable ZFP Networkable Fire Panels
summary: The Context Plus ZREP1S is an intelligent addressable ZFP network device that can be used as a traditional but compact repeater panel with added functionality.
description: Includes a Z41 Touchscreen Control Module and ZHN ‘Hi-Net’ multi-path fault-tolerant network PCB.
Housed in a stylish surface mounting plastic enclosure measuring just 214mm x 178mm x 70mm.
Can be used to an enhance a building’s reception area and access points (locate your main ZFP panels out of sight and let our ZFP Compact Controllers add a touch of class to your surroundings).
Full Access Level 2 functionality (silence, disable, reset, etc).
Requires a separate EN54-4 boxed PSU such as our BF360-24 1A 24V boxed PSU.
Up to 64 Compact Controllers can be connected to a ZFP network (each controller classed as 1 network node).

specs.label: Power requirements
specs.value: Requires a separate EN54-4 PSU such as our BF360-24 1.5A 24V boxed PSU.Indicators : Full-colour 480 x 272 pixel touchscreen; 16 LEDS (11 reserved for mandatory EN54 indicators).

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: Interactive touchscreen with menu sensitive buttons; 1 x keyswitch allowing direct access to Access Level 2. Keyswitch requires S-KEY fire panel key.

specs.label: Product dimensions
specs.value: (mm) 214 W x 178 H x 70 D mm. Surface mounting.

specs.label: Construction & finish
specs.value: Plastic detachable lid and back box. RAL7035.

specs.label: Notes
specs.value: Up to 64 ZFP Compact Controllers can be connected to a ZFP 'Hi-Net' Network. See Instructions for further details.
